"""Author paragraph (c)(1) unmarked-pavement boundary requests."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE=HERE.parent.parent
ROOT=CASE.parents[1]
SOURCE='does not travel more than 200 feet in the section of pavement not marked as a traffic lane; or (2)'
BOUNDARY_M=60.96
POLICIES={'primary':(8.0,'standard',None),
          'fallback1':(7.0,'standard',None),
          'fallback2':(8.0,'elevated_overview',None),
          'fallback3':(8.0,'standard',45.0)}


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def put(path,value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
def put_rows(path,values):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n'
                            for v in values))


def road():

    assignment=ROOT/'inputs'/CASE.name/'assignment.json'

    for witness,distance in (('exception_3_1',61.06),('exception_3_2',BOUNDARY_M)):

            target=HERE/'drafts'/witness/candidate

            values=[]
            for i in range(240):
                t=(i+1)/20;x=min(stop or 300,5+speed*t)

            track=target/'requested-tracks.jsonl';put_rows(track,values)
            cfg={'format':'c146314-paragraph-c1-request-v1',
                'assignment_id':CASE.name,'case_id':case_id,
                'candidate_id':candidate,'source_branch':'NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(1)',
                'assignment_sha256':sha(assignment),

                'road_sha256':sha(road_path),'tracks_sha256':sha(track),

                'stop_x_m':stop,'unmarked_segment_start_x_m':20,

"""Check copied paragraph (c)(1) boundary request without claiming (c)(2)."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import SOURCE, BOUNDARY_M


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def rows(path):return [json.loads(s) for s in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
def require(ok,message):
    if not ok:raise ValueError(message)


def check(bundle):
    bundle=Path(bundle)
    cfg=read(bundle/'config.json')
    plan=read(bundle/'case-plan.json')
    assignment=read(bundle/'assignment-source.json')
    source=plan['source_law']['text']
    require(source==assignment['law_record']['text'] and
        hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()==
        '525f777bf701d9e420e3541071bc6b10de85f747a53fb044431e00826bfee06a'
        and SOURCE in source and
        'does not travel through an intersection or past any private way' in source,
        'frozen disjunctive paragraph (c) source')
    road=ET.parse(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr').getroot()
    lanes=road.findall('./road/lanes/laneSection/right/lane')
    require(road.find('./road').attrib['id']=='212' and
        [(int(l.attrib['id']),l.attrib['type']) for l in lanes]==
            [(-1,'driving'),(-2,'shoulder')] and
        all(float(l.find('width').attrib['a'])==3.5 for l in lanes) and
        lanes[1].find('roadMark').attrib['type']=='none',
        'unmarked authored pavement geometry')
    track=rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    witness=cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-1]
    distance=61.06 if witness=='exception_3_1' else BOUNDARY_M
    speed=7 if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback1' else 8
    stop=45 if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback3' else None
    camera='elevated_overview' if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback2' else 'standard'
    exit_x=20+distance
    require(witness in ('exception_3_1','exception_3_2') and
        cfg['format']=='c146314-paragraph-c1-request-v1' and
        cfg['assignment_sha256']==sha(bundle/'assignment-source.json') and
        cfg['case_plan_sha256']==sha(bundle/'case-plan.json') and
        cfg['road_sha256']==sha(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr') and
        cfg['tracks_sha256']==sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl') and
        cfg['source_branch']=='NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(1)' and
        cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps']==speed and
        cfg['camera_policy']==camera and cfg['stop_x_m']==stop and
        cfg['unmarked_segment_start_x_m']==20 and
        math.isclose(cfg['unmarked_segment_end_x_m'],exit_x,abs_tol=1e-6) and
        cfg['requested_excursion_m']==distance and
        cfg['requested_c1_within_200ft']==(distance<=BOUNDARY_M) and
        cfg['rate_hz']==20 and cfg['frames']==len(track)==240 and
        cfg['status']=='unselected_native_request' and
        all(cfg[k] is False for k in ('c2_crossing_verified',
            'unmarked_pavement_verified','actual_excursion_observed',
            'actual_right_pass_observed','original_native_observed')),
        'source-bound candidate and numeric boundary')
    pass_frames=0
    for i,row in enumerate(track):
        t=(i+1)/20;x=min(stop or 300,5+speed*t)
        blend=max(0,min(1,(x-16.2)/5,(exit_x+3.8-x)/5))
        y=-1.75-3.5*blend
        require(row['frame']==i and row['time_s']==t and
            row['source_kind']=='authored_native_request' and
            row['source_branch']=='NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(1)' and
            row['case_id']==cfg['case_id'] and
            row['candidate_id']==cfg['candidate_id'] and
            row['road_id']==212 and
            math.isclose(row['ego_x_m'],x,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            math.isclose(row['ego_y_m'],y,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            row['requested_surface']==('unmarked_right_pavement' if blend>=.99
                else 'driving_or_transition') and
            math.isclose(row['lead_x_m'],35+4*t,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            row['lead_y_m']==-1.75 and
            row['unmarked_segment_start_x_m']==20 and
            math.isclose(row['unmarked_segment_end_x_m'],exit_x,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            row['requested_excursion_m']==distance and
            all(row[k] is False for k in
                ('private_way_or_intersection_crossing_verified',
                 'unmarked_pavement_verified','pavement_unobstructed_verified',
                 'no_parked_vehicles_verified','actual_right_pass_observed')) and
            row['legal_verdict'] is None,
            f'authored boundary frame {i}')
        pass_frames+=int(x>row['lead_x_m'] and blend>=.99)
    require((pass_frames==0)==(stop is not None),'pass/stop request split')
    return {'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':cfg['candidate_id'],
        'requested_excursion_m':distance,
        'requested_c1_within_200ft':distance<=BOUNDARY_M,
        'requested_right_ahead_frames':pass_frames,
        'c2_crossing_verified':False,'original_native_observed':False,
        'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,required=True)
    print(json.dumps(check(p.parse_args().bundle)))

"""Unaccepted CARLA attempt for the exact C146314 paragraph (c)(1) unmarked-pavement right-pass request."""

import check


def sha(path):

def repository():
    for parent in (Path(__file__).resolve().parent,*Path(__file__).resolve().parents):
        if (parent/'batch.json').is_file() and (parent/'runtime').is_dir():
            return parent
    raise ValueError('Pinned runtime repository unavailable')


def write_new(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def pose(actor):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    body=actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    return {'actor_id':actor.id,'blueprint':actor.type_id,
        'center_native_xyz_m':[transform.location.x,transform.location.y,
                               transform.location.z],
        'yaw_deg':transform.rotation.yaw,
        'velocity_native_xyz_mps':[velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z],
        'speed_mps':math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
        'body_native_xyz_m':[[p.x,p.y,p.z] for p in body]}


def steer_to(carla,actor,target_x,target_y,target_speed):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    speed=math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)
    if target_speed<=.05:
        return carla.VehicleControl(steer=0,throttle=0,
                                    brake=max(.5,min(1,speed)))
    angle=math.atan2(target_y-transform.location.y,
                     target_x-transform.location.x)
    error=math.atan2(math.sin(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)),
                     math.cos(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)))
    return carla.VehicleControl(steer=max(-.65,min(.65,1.4*error)),
        throttle=max(0,min(1,.2+.24*(target_speed-speed))),
        brake=max(0,min(1,.35*(speed-target_speed))))


def execute(bundle,output,host,port):

    owned=[];videos={};logs={};camera_queues={}

                    image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<frame:
                        image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=frame:
                        raise RuntimeError('Native camera-frame join differs')
                    rgb=np.frombuffer(image.raw_data,dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
                        height,width,4)[:,:,:3][:,:,::-1]
                    videos[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                frame_map.write(json.dumps({'video_frame':i,
                    'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s},
                    allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                frames+=1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),
               'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:
            try:pipeline.close(confirmed=error is None)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'pipeline_close_error':str(exc)}
        for name,process in videos.items():
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=180)!=0:
                    raise RuntimeError('Lossless video encoder failed: '+name)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'video_encoder_error':str(exc)}
            logs[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith('sensor.') and actor.is_listening:
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'cleanup_error':str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:restored=restore(client,saved)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'restore_error':str(exc)}
        write_new(output/'native-capture-report.json',{
            'case_id':checked['case_id'],'candidate_id':checked['candidate_id'],
            'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
            'requested_frames':240,'observed_frames':frames,
            'restoration':restored,'error':error,'accepted':False,
            'authored_shoulder_lane_readback':lanes_verified,
            'pavement_condition_verified':False,
            'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False})
    if error:
        raise RuntimeError('C146314 Native attempt failed; see capture report')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,default=Path.cwd())
    p.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--host',default='127.0.0.1')
    p.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000)
    a=p.parse_args()
    if a.check:
        print(json.dumps(check.check(a.bundle)))
    else:
        if a.output_dir is None:
            p.error('--output-dir is required outside --check')
        execute(a.bundle,a.output_dir,a.host,a.port)

"""Source-bound paragraph (c)(1) raw preparation and conservative distance measurement."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from check import check

RAW = ('native-map-readback.json', 'native-raw-actors.jsonl',
       'video_frames.jsonl', 'frame-review.jsonl', 'native-capture-report.json')
BOUNDARY_M = 60.96


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def finite(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def vehicle(value, actor_id):
    require(type(value) is dict and value.get('actor_id') == actor_id and
            value.get('blueprint') == 'vehicle.tesla.model3', 'actor identity')
    center = value.get('center_native_xyz_m')
    velocity = value.get('velocity_native_xyz_mps')
    body = value.get('body_native_xyz_m')
    require(type(center) is list and len(center) == 3 and all(map(finite, center)) and
            type(velocity) is list and len(velocity) == 3 and all(map(finite, velocity)) and
            finite(value.get('yaw_deg')) and finite(value.get('speed_mps')) and
            value['speed_mps'] >= 0 and
            abs(math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in velocity))-value['speed_mps']) < .01 and
            type(body) is list and len(body) == 8 and
            all(type(p) is list and len(p) == 3 and all(map(finite, p)) for p in body),
            'actor pose/body/speed')
    xs = [p[0] for p in body]
    ys = [p[1] for p in body]
    require(3 <= max(xs)-min(xs) <= 7 and 1.3 <= max(ys)-min(ys) <= 7 and
            abs((max(xs)+min(xs))/2-center[0]) < 1 and
            abs((max(ys)+min(ys))/2-center[1]) < 1 and
            len({(round(p[0], 4), round(p[1], 4)) for p in body}) == 4,
            'actor body geometry')
    return value


def media_hashes(raw, synthetic):
    if synthetic:
        return {}
    result = {}
    for name in ('forward.mkv', 'overview.mkv'):
        result[name] = sha(raw/name)
        probe = subprocess.run(['ffprobe', '-v', 'error', '-count_frames',
                                '-select_streams', 'v:0',
                                '-show_entries', 'stream=codec_name,nb_read_frames',
                                '-of', 'json', str(raw/name)], capture_output=True,
                               text=True, check=True, timeout=120)
        streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get('streams', [])
        require(len(streams) == 1 and streams[0].get('codec_name') == 'ffv1' and
                streams[0].get('nb_read_frames') == '240', 'original FFV1 frames')
    return result


def prepare(bundle, raw, output, synthetic=False):
    bundle, raw, output = map(Path, (bundle, raw, output))
    checked = check(bundle)
    cfg = read(bundle/'config.json')
    require(not output.exists(), 'saved output must be fresh')
    hashes = {name: sha(raw/name) for name in RAW}
    mapping = read(raw/RAW[0])
    report = read(raw/RAW[-1])
    observed = rows(raw/RAW[1])
    video = rows(raw/RAW[2])
    reviews = rows(raw/RAW[3])
    requests = rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    kind = 'synthetic_cpu' if synthetic else 'original_native'
    require(len(observed) == len(video) == len(reviews) == len(requests) == 240,
            '240-frame coverage')
    lane_map = {str(n): {'road_id': 212, 'lane_id': n} for n in (-2, -1)}
    require(mapping.get('source_kind') == kind and
            mapping.get('road_sha256') == sha(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr') and
            type(mapping.get('native_map_sha256')) is str and
            len(mapping['native_map_sha256']) == 64 and
            mapping.get('driving_lane_readback') == lane_map and
            mapping.get('authored_shoulder_lane_readback') is True and
            type(mapping.get('ego_actor_id')) is int and
            type(mapping.get('lead_actor_id')) is int and
            mapping['ego_actor_id'] != mapping['lead_actor_id'] and
            mapping.get('pavement_condition_verified') is False and
            mapping.get('legal_verdict') is None, 'map and actor binding')
    require(report.get('case_id') == checked['case_id'] and
            report.get('candidate_id') == checked['candidate_id'] and
            report.get('config_sha256') == sha(bundle/'config.json') and
            report.get('requested_frames') == report.get('observed_frames') == 240 and
            report.get('error') is None and report.get('accepted') is False and
            report.get('delivery_ready') is False and
            report.get('authored_shoulder_lane_readback') is True and
            report.get('pavement_condition_verified') is False and
            report.get('legal_verdict') is None, 'unaccepted capture report')
    media = media_hashes(raw, synthetic)
    first = observed[0].get('native_frame')
    require(type(first) is int, 'first native frame')
    saved, cameras = [], []
    for i, (row, frame, review, request) in enumerate(zip(observed, video, reviews, requests)):
        native, time = first+i, row.get('time_s')
        require(row.get('frame') == i and row.get('native_frame') == native and
                row.get('source_kind') == kind and finite(time) and
                abs(time-(i+1)/20) < .005 and
                row.get('requested_ego_x_m') == request['ego_x_m'] and
                row.get('requested_ego_y_m') == request['ego_y_m'] and
                row.get('requested_lead_x_m') == request['lead_x_m'] and
                row.get('observed_ego_road_id') == 212 and
                row.get('observed_ego_lane_id') in (-1, -2) and
                row.get('observed_lead_road_id') == 212 and
                row.get('observed_lead_lane_id') == -1 and
                row.get('authored_shoulder_lane_readback') is True and
                row.get('pavement_condition_verified') is False and
                row.get('legal_verdict') is None, f'actor/request join {i}')
        require(frame.get('video_frame') == i and frame.get('native_frame') == native and
                finite(frame.get('time_s')) and abs(frame['time_s']-time) < 1e-6 and
                review.get('frame') == i and review.get('native_frame') == native and
                finite(review.get('time_s')) and abs(review['time_s']-time) < 1e-6 and
                review.get('source_kind') == kind and
                review.get('review_provenance') ==
                    ('synthetic_cpu' if synthetic else 'human_frame_review') and
                review.get('forward_video_sha256') == media.get('forward.mkv', 'synthetic_cpu') and
                review.get('overview_video_sha256') == media.get('overview.mkv', 'synthetic_cpu') and
                type(review.get('boundary_pixel_reviewed')) is bool and
                type(review.get('pavement_pixel_reviewed')) is bool and
                (type(review.get('unmarked_pavement_visible')) is bool
                 if review['pavement_pixel_reviewed'] else
                 review.get('unmarked_pavement_visible') is None),
                f'video/review join {i}')
        ego = vehicle(row.get('ego'), mapping['ego_actor_id'])
        lead = vehicle(row.get('lead'), mapping['lead_actor_id'])
        saved.append({'frame': i, 'native_frame': native, 'time_s': time,
                      'source_kind': kind, 'ego': ego, 'lead': lead,
                      'observed_ego_lane_id': row['observed_ego_lane_id'],
                      'observed_lead_lane_id': row['observed_lead_lane_id']})
        cameras.append({'frame': i, 'native_frame': native,
                        'video_frame': i, 'time_s': time, 'source_kind': kind})
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, data in (('native-observed.jsonl', saved),
                       ('camera-frames.jsonl', cameras),
                       ('frame-review.jsonl', reviews)):
        (output/name).write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False)+'\n'
                                         for row in data))
    receipt = {'format': 'c146314-paragraph-c1-raw-to-saved-v1',
               'case_id': cfg['case_id'], 'candidate_id': cfg['candidate_id'],
               'source_kind': kind, 'config_sha256': sha(bundle/'config.json'),
               'raw_hashes': hashes, 'media_hashes': media,
               'saved_hashes': {name: sha(output/name) for name in
                                ('native-observed.jsonl', 'camera-frames.jsonl',
                                 'frame-review.jsonl')},
               'original_native_observed': not synthetic,
               'human_boundary_reviewed': all(r['boundary_pixel_reviewed'] for r in reviews),
               'pavement_condition_verified': False, 'legal_verdict': None,
               'delivery_ready': False}
    (output/'preparation-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
    return receipt


def measure(bundle, saved_dir):
    bundle, saved_dir = map(Path, (bundle, saved_dir))
    check(bundle)
    receipt = read(saved_dir/'preparation-receipt.json')
    cfg = read(bundle/'config.json')
    observations = rows(saved_dir/'native-observed.jsonl')
    cameras = rows(saved_dir/'camera-frames.jsonl')
    reviews = rows(saved_dir/'frame-review.jsonl')
    require(receipt.get('config_sha256') == sha(bundle/'config.json') and
            receipt.get('source_kind') in ('synthetic_cpu', 'original_native') and
            receipt.get('original_native_observed') ==
                (receipt.get('source_kind') == 'original_native') and
            receipt.get('pavement_condition_verified') is False and
            receipt.get('legal_verdict') is None and
            receipt.get('delivery_ready') is False and
            all(receipt['saved_hashes'][name] == sha(saved_dir/name) for name in
                ('native-observed.jsonl', 'camera-frames.jsonl', 'frame-review.jsonl')) and
            len(observations) == len(cameras) == len(reviews) == 240,
            'prepared source hashes and rows')
    full, pass_frames, reviewed = [], 0, 0
    for i, (row, cam, review) in enumerate(zip(observations, cameras, reviews)):
        require(row['frame'] == cam['frame'] == review['frame'] == i and
                row['native_frame'] == cam['native_frame'] == review['native_frame'] and
                row['source_kind'] == cam['source_kind'] == review['source_kind'] ==
                    receipt['source_kind'], f'prepared frame join {i}')
        ego, lead = row['ego']['body_native_xyz_m'], row['lead']['body_native_xyz_m']
        ex = [p[0] for p in ego]
        ey = [p[1] for p in ego]
        lx = [p[0] for p in lead]
        ly = [p[1] for p in lead]
        full.append(row['observed_ego_lane_id'] == -2 and
                    min(ey) >= -7 and max(ey) <= -3.5)
        pass_frames += int(min(ex) > max(lx) and max(ey) < min(ly))
        reviewed += int(review['boundary_pixel_reviewed'] and
                        review['pavement_pixel_reviewed'])
    spans = []
    start = None
    for i, occupied in enumerate(full + [False]):
        if occupied and start is None:
            start = i
        if not occupied and start is not None:
            end = i-1
            centers = [observations[j]['ego']['center_native_xyz_m'] for j in range(start, end+1)]
            lower = sum(math.dist(a[:2], b[:2]) for a, b in zip(centers, centers[1:]))
            before = observations[max(0, start-1)]['ego']['center_native_xyz_m']
            after = observations[min(239, end+1)]['ego']['center_native_xyz_m']
            uncertainty = math.dist(before[:2], centers[0][:2]) + math.dist(centers[-1][:2], after[:2])
            complete_exit = end < 239
            spans.append({'first_frame': start, 'last_frame': end,
                          'exit_observed': complete_exit,
                          'sampled_distance_lower_m': round(lower, 6),
                          'boundary_uncertainty_m': round(uncertainty, 6),
                          'distance_upper_m': round(lower+uncertainty, 6) if complete_exit else None,
                          'boundary_relation': ('incomplete_exit' if not complete_exit else
                              'within_200ft' if lower+uncertainty <= BOUNDARY_M
                              else 'over_200ft' if lower > BOUNDARY_M else 'ambiguous')})
            start = None
    return {'format': 'c146314-paragraph-c1-prepared-measurement-v1',
            'case_id': cfg['case_id'], 'candidate_id': cfg['candidate_id'],
            'source_kind': receipt['source_kind'],
            'requested_excursion_m': cfg['requested_excursion_m'],
            'requested_distance_is_observed_distance': False,
            'full_body_unmarked_frames': sum(full), 'spans': spans,
            'right_pass_frames': pass_frames, 'reviewed_boundary_pavement_frames': reviewed,
            'original_native_observed': receipt['original_native_observed'],
            'pavement_condition_verified': False, 'legal_verdict': None,
            'delivery_ready': False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--bundle', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--raw-folder', type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--saved-folder', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--synthetic-cpu', action='store_true')
    a = p.parse_args()
    if a.raw_folder:
        print(json.dumps(prepare(a.bundle, a.raw_folder, a.saved_folder, a.synthetic_cpu)))
    else:
        print(json.dumps(measure(a.bundle, a.saved_folder)))

"""Raw-shaped synthetic CPU fixture; never an original Native observation."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from build import put, put_rows, sha


def actor(actor_id, x, y, vx, vy=0):
    corners = ((x-2, y-.9), (x-2, y+.9),
               (x+2, y+.9), (x+2, y-.9))
    return {'actor_id': actor_id, 'blueprint': 'vehicle.tesla.model3',
            'center_native_xyz_m': [x, y, 1.5], 'yaw_deg': 0,
            'velocity_native_xyz_mps': [vx, vy, 0],
            'speed_mps': round((vx*vx+vy*vy)**.5, 6),
            'body_native_xyz_m': [[round(px, 6), round(py, 6), z]
                                   for z in (.5, 2.5) for px, py in corners]}


def build(bundle, output):
    bundle, output = map(Path, (bundle, output))
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError('raw output must be fresh')
    cfg = json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    requests = [json.loads(line) for line in
                (bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(requests) != 240:
        raise ValueError('request count')
    put(output/'native-map-readback.json', {
        'source_kind': 'synthetic_cpu',
        'road_sha256': sha(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr'),
        'native_map_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'synthetic-c146314-road-212').hexdigest(),
        'driving_lane_readback': {str(n): {'road_id': 212, 'lane_id': n}
                                  for n in (-2, -1)},
        'ego_actor_id': 101, 'lead_actor_id': 102,
        'authored_shoulder_lane_readback': True,
        'pavement_condition_verified': False, 'legal_verdict': None})
    actors, videos, reviews = [], [], []
    for i, request in enumerate(requests):
        x, y, lx, t = (request[key] for key in
                       ('ego_x_m', 'ego_y_m', 'lead_x_m', 'time_s'))
        native = i+1000
        previous = requests[i-1] if i else request
        vx = round((x-previous['ego_x_m'])*20, 6)
        vy = round((y-previous['ego_y_m'])*20, 6)
        actors.append({'frame': i, 'native_frame': native, 'time_s': t,
                       'source_kind': 'synthetic_cpu',
                       'requested_ego_x_m': x, 'requested_ego_y_m': y,
                       'requested_lead_x_m': lx,
                       'observed_ego_road_id': 212,
                       'observed_ego_lane_id': -2 if y < -3.5 else -1,
                       'observed_lead_road_id': 212, 'observed_lead_lane_id': -1,
                       'ego': actor(101, x, y, vx, vy),
                       'lead': actor(102, lx, -1.75, 4),
                       'requested_lead_left_signal': False,
                       'observed_lead_light_state': 0,
                       'observed_lead_left_blinker': False,
                       'authored_shoulder_lane_readback': True,
                       'pavement_condition_verified': False, 'legal_verdict': None})
        videos.append({'video_frame': i, 'native_frame': native, 'time_s': t})
        reviews.append({'frame': i, 'native_frame': native, 'time_s': t,
                        'source_kind': 'synthetic_cpu',
                        'review_provenance': 'synthetic_cpu',
                        'forward_video_sha256': 'synthetic_cpu',
                        'overview_video_sha256': 'synthetic_cpu',
                        'boundary_pixel_reviewed': False,
                        'pavement_pixel_reviewed': False,
                        'unmarked_pavement_visible': None})
    put_rows(output/'native-raw-actors.jsonl', actors)
    put_rows(output/'video_frames.jsonl', videos)
    put_rows(output/'frame-review.jsonl', reviews)
    put(output/'native-capture-report.json', {
        'case_id': cfg['case_id'], 'candidate_id': cfg['candidate_id'],
        'config_sha256': sha(bundle/'config.json'),
        'requested_frames': 240, 'observed_frames': 240,
        'restoration': {'synthetic_cpu': True}, 'error': None,
        'accepted': False, 'authored_shoulder_lane_readback': True,
        'pavement_condition_verified': False, 'legal_verdict': None,
        'delivery_ready': False})
    return {'source_kind': 'synthetic_cpu', 'frames': 240}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--bundle', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--output-dir', type=Path, required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(build(a.bundle, a.output_dir)))

"""Record measured paragraph (c)(1) fallback eligibility without selecting a case."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from saved import measure


def route(bundle, saved):
    measured = measure(bundle, saved)
    spans = measured['spans']
    relation = spans[0]['boundary_relation'] if len(spans) == 1 else 'missing_or_multiple_spans'
    missing_pass = measured['right_pass_frames'] < 1
    distance_uncertain = relation in ('ambiguous', 'incomplete_exit', 'missing_or_multiple_spans')
    review_missing = measured['reviewed_boundary_pavement_frames'] < 240
    original_missing = not measured['original_native_observed']
    return {'format': 'c146314-paragraph-c1-measured-routing-v1',
            'case_id': measured['case_id'],
            'candidate_id': measured['candidate_id'],
            'source_kind': measured['source_kind'],
            'measured_boundary_relation': relation,
            'triggers': {
                'fallback1': {'eligible': missing_pass or distance_uncertain,
                              'measured_right_pass_frames': measured['right_pass_frames'],
                              'boundary_relation': relation,
                              'reason': 'insufficient full-body pass or uncertain sampled distance'},
                'fallback2': {'eligible': review_missing,
                              'measured_reviewed_boundary_pavement_frames':
                                  measured['reviewed_boundary_pavement_frames'],
                              'reason': 'fewer than 240 reviewed boundary/pavement frames'},
                'fallback3': {'eligible': original_missing or relation == 'incomplete_exit',
                              'original_native_observed': measured['original_native_observed'],
                              'exit_observed': len(spans) == 1 and spans[0]['exit_observed'],
                              'reason': 'missing original Native evidence or incomplete exit'}},
            'selected_fallback': None, 'delivery_ready': False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--bundle', type=Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument('--saved', type=Path, required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(route(a.bundle, a.saved)))
